 Order
This bail application is filed under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioners are accused Nos. 1 to 3 in Crime No.338/2025 of Pantheerankavu Police Station,
Kozhikode District; alleging offence under Section 498A, 406 r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3.

The prosecution case is that, the first accused married the de facto complainant on 29.12.208 and thereafter harassed her physically and mentally and misappropriated 100 sovereigns of gold pursuant to their demand for dowry, thus committing the offences alleged.
Petitioners are the husband, mother-in-law and father-in-law respectively of the de facto complainant.
4. The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners would submit that petitioners are absolutely innocent and that they are falsely implicated in a crime for justifying a matrimonial dispute.
5. I have heard the learned Public Prosecutor also.

6. Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations, I am of the opinion that BAIL APPL. NO. 5893 OF 2025 2025:KER:37959 petitioners can be granted anticipatory bail subject to conditions, since the dispute stands from a matrimonial relationship.

It is directed that the petitioners shall be released on anticipatory bail, in the event of their arrest in Crime No.338/2025 of Pantheerankavu Police Station, Kozhikode District; subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Petitioners shall execute separate bonds for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum before the Investigating Officer.
(ii) Petitioners shall appear before the investigating officer in Crime No.338/2025 of Pantheerankavu Police Station, Kozhikode District; as and when required.
(iii) Petitioners shall not attempt to contact the de facto complainant or interfere with the investigation or to influence or intimidate any witness in Crime No.338/2025 of Pantheerankavu Police Station, Kozhikode District.
(iv) Petitioners shall not involve in any other similar crimes while on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.338/2025 of Pantheerankavu Police Station, Kozhikode District; may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.
